summary: Verastem, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an underwritten public offering of 30,937,500 shares of common stock at $8.00 per share, plus pre-funded warrants for up to 312,503 shares priced at $7.9999, raising roughly $250.0 million in gross proceeds ($235.0 million net of underwriting discounts before expenses). The offering follows a $7.45 last reported sale price on October 13, 2026, implying a modest premium. Jefferies, Guggenheim Securities and Cantor are joint book-running managers, with B. Riley Securities as lead manager. Delivery is expected on or about October 15, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and dilution.
